title: 第11章 日内盈利首破二十万
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
转眼周一。

    李西海休息了一天，也恢复过来了。

    不做农活的人，下田一天，那种酸爽只有自己知道。

    李西朋还在微信上叫苦不迭的。

    父母吃过饭就出门上班，李西海躺在沙发上，等着大A开市。

    9:25。

    竞价阶段在一番博弈后，平开。

    这没什么好意外的。

    系统预知一如既往的稳。

    9:30。

    时间一到，准时开盘，交易界面数字也在跳动。

    久岸医疗在连续五个涨停板后，当前股价64.23/股，相比于上周一的39.88，股价涨幅高达61.05%。

    这绝对是一个骇人的涨幅。

    一个人要是全仓吃满这一阶段的涨幅，可以说绝对是一个有眼光有足够定力的投资者。

    要是普通投资者，怕是早就在吃一个涨停，就中途跳车了。

    李西海或许贪婪，但二三十个点的涨幅，也怕是拿不住。

    好在他有预知提供参考。

    稳的一匹。

    看着多空之间的拉扯，涨幅在缓慢的上升。

    李西海果断在6.9点，也就是68.66元的价位提前挂了全仓卖单。

    只要股价达到挂卖价位，将自动成交。

    点开多档价位，看到自己的挂卖成功挂在上面，李西海放心下来。

    时间一点点流逝。

    9：55。

    手机弹出交易成功的消息。

    李西海挂在的全仓卖单顺利成交。

    账户信息：

    持仓标的：久岸医疗（000580）

    持股数量：0

    成本/现价：0

    持仓市值：0

    当日盈利：111125

    浮动盈亏：721635

    总资产：1721635

    六个交易日，李西海一百万本金，做到一百七十二万。

    资产涨幅：72%。

    这是惊人的能力。

    平均下来，每天都是十几万的盈利。

    足够震惊无数大A韭菜，他们做梦都想有一天能这样赚钱。

    李西海却表示很淡定。

    他在手机上开始操作，反手就在跌停的价位上，全仓挂买。

    170万，直接梭哈，在跌停价位排队。
content_en:
Fast forward to Monday.

    Li Xihai rested for a day and recovered.

    For those who don’t do farm work, only they know the sour feeling they feel after going to the fields for a day.

    Li Xipeng still complained endlessly on WeChat.

    His parents went to work after dinner. Li Xihai lay on the sofa, waiting for the big A market to open.

    9:25.

    In the bidding stage, after a lot of games, it was opened flat.

    This is nothing surprising.

    System prediction is as stable as ever.

    9:30.

    When the time comes, the market opens on time, and the numbers on the trading interface are also beating.

    After five consecutive daily limits, Jiu'an Medical's current stock price is 64.23 per share. Compared with last Monday's 39.88, the stock price has increased by as much as 61.05%.

    This is an absolutely astonishing increase.

    If a person fully absorbs the gains at this stage, it can be said that he is definitely an investor with sufficient vision and determination.

    If you are an ordinary investor, you may have already hit the daily limit and jumped out of the market midway.

    Li Xihai may be greedy, but he may not be able to hold on to an increase of twenty or thirty points.

    Fortunately, he had foreknowledge to provide reference.

    A stable horse.

    Looking at the pull between long and short, the increase is slowly rising.

    Li Xihai decisively placed a full sell order in advance at 6.9 points, which is the price of 68.66 yuan.

    As long as the stock price reaches the selling price, the transaction will be automatically completed.

    Clicking on the multiple price levels, Li Xihai felt relieved when he saw that his listing was successfully listed.

    Time passes little by little.

    9:55.

    A successful transaction message pops up on your phone.

    The full sell order placed by Li Xihai was successfully completed.

    Account information:

    Position target: Jiuan Medical (000580)

    Number of shares held: 0

    Cost/current price: 0

    Position market value: 0

    Profit for the day: 111125

    Floating profit and loss: 721635

    Total assets: 1,721,635

    In six trading days, Li Xihai's capital of one million reached 1.72 million.

    Asset growth: 72%.

    This is amazing ability.

    On average, the profit is more than 100,000 yuan every day.

    It is enough to shock countless big A leeks, they all dream of making money like this one day.

    Li Xihai expressed his calmness.

    He started the operation on his mobile phone, and his backhand was at the lower limit price, and he placed a full position to buy.

    1.7 million, directly stud, queuing up at the lower limit price.
title_en: Chapter 11 Intraday profit exceeded 200,000 for the first time
